categories.name: docs
categories.evidence: Matches the Docs label and directly adds `doc/error-handling.md` as developer guidance and project design documentation.
categories.rationale: Resolving the project's error-handling strategy removes a recurring burden of ad-hoc architectural debates across multiple subsystems. The description notes that Bitcoin Core lacks a unified strategy, causing repeated disputes in validation and subsystem PRs, and this guidance directly enables decisions in #34931, #35003, and #34132. Although the specific model proposed is heavily disputed by reviewers, the underlying problem requires project-wide architectural alignment.
